answer: Stop sybils with a lantern echo check: an agent joins a nebula pool by staking a bond, then answers a lantern challenge with its echo in one window. Verifiers void a bond whose echo is copied, late, or answers two challenges, slashing it. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and echoes at 17x honest cost each: each echo fits one lantern, one window, and one entry, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
